visits.heading: Visits
visits.about: Each page the website shows is one view. Visitors are told apart within a day only, without cookies. Each view keeps the IP address it came from and that address's country or region; this page shows them by country or region only, never the addresses. Days and hours are those of your time zone.

featured.intro: The playlists chosen are shown on the home page in this order, {{max}} at most. Only public playlists can be chosen, fanmade or official. With none chosen the home page leaves the section out.

announcements.heading: Announcements
announcements.adminIntro: Announcements are shown at the top right of the home page (the first 3) and on the announcements page: pinned ones first, then the newest. The text is written in Markdown: headings, lists, links, pictures, tables and code all work, and web addresses become links.

songAdmin.heading: Manage songs
songAdmin.intro: Categories players suggest for Fanmade's songs, decided by Fanmade's managers. Accepting or rejecting one settles every suggestion of that category for that song, including later ones; accepting takes a song that was only in Variety out of Variety.

danAdmin.heading: Review Dan courses
danAdmin.intro: Changing the songs or conditions of a course with fixed songs takes a request, which the managers of its library decide. Approving gives the course what was asked and fixes it again from now (earlier attempts no longer count for rules); returning needs a reply. The maker is notified either way.
